generated: hand-maintained; kunumi_lookup.py reads this file as the single source of truth
notes: Institutional color and typography values were read from the brandbook's own Figma variables, not inferred.
Values marked deck-derived come from the 2026 slide templates and the Ksequence product deck, not from the brandbook. They are retained for template fidelity and are subordinate to the brandbook.
letterSpacing is expressed in percent of the font size. The brandbook stores 3 for PP Neue Machina, which renders as 0.66px at 22px, confirming percent.

Figma variables are named by value (space/24 is 24px); CSS custom properties are named by 4px multiple (--kunumi-space-6 is 24px). geometry.spacing.entries is the bridge between the two and is the only authority for that mapping.

Corrected 2026-08-21: five hexes (#FF9516, #FF6330, #D73E5F, #9355A0, #5A61B6) were filed under deckSpectrum/deckSupport as 2026-slide-template material. They are brandbook Instituto gradient stops, read from brandbook/instituto/cor slide 05. amarelo #FF931E and laranja #F26638 really are deck-only and stayed put.

Added 2026-09-29: a web product layer (color.product, color.semantic, typography.productRamp, typography.fluid, layout, motion, elevation, interaction, components, icons, logo, digital). The brandbook was drawn for graphic and print material and prints none of these values. Every block carries an authority saying where its numbers come from: the Kosmos Figma library (which mirrors this file, not the other way round), a platform convention such as WCAG 2.2 or Open Graph, or a channel's published format. Values still awaiting brand approval carry status: proposed. See references/web-specs.md.

institutional.role: PALETA PRINCIPAL. Solid use in text, backgrounds, and basic graphic resources.

entries.name: URUCUM
entries.role: Primary accent, emphasis, calls to action, the Unlimited positive lockup

entries.name: CHUMBO
entries.role: Main text, dark ground, positive core and Instituto marks. Replaces black.

entries.name: GELO
entries.role: Main light ground and negative mark color. Replaces white.

prohibition.rule: As cores chumbo (#1C2127) e gelo (#F0F0F0) substituem o preto e o branco, que não devem ser utilizados.
prohibition.appliesTo: Brand color: page grounds, body and display text, graphic resources, rules, chart ink.

observedException.where: The brandbook's own card components (tomDeVoz/principios/card, introducao/Cards) use a white surface on a Gelo ground.
observedException.reading: White is permitted only as an elevated surface sitting on Gelo. It is never a page ground, a text color, or a brand color. Black has no such exception.

prohibition.institutoGradientException: #000000 is permitted as the terminus of the Instituto signature gradient, and nowhere else. Never a page ground, a text colour, or a brand colour. See color.instituto.

chart.role: PALETA PARA GRAFICOS. Developed exclusively for data representation; use only in that context.
chart.rule: Esta paleta foi desenvolvida exclusivamente para a representação de dados e utilização em gráficos e deve ser utilizada apenas nesse contexto. Ela abrange novas cores que funcionam como uma extensão controlada da identidade cromática da marca.
chart.seriesOrderObserved: The brandbook's own line chart plots blue, cyan, yellow, green top-to-bottom. The brandbook does not state this as a rule.
chart.unnamed: The brandbook prints only the hex for these five. No name, RGB, CMYK, or Pantone equivalent exists; do not invent one.

instituto.role: GRADIENTE-ASSINATURA DO INSTITUTO KUNUMI. Seven stops measured off a 1918px bar.
instituto.authority: Brandbook Kunumi Final (2025), chapter brandbook/instituto/cor, slide 05.
instituto.scope: Instituto Kunumi only. Core Kunumi and Unlimited stay restrained - this is not a general-purpose accent palette.
instituto.dominance: Urucum occupies 542 of 1918 band pixels, 28% of the bar - nearly triple any other stop. The ramp is urucum-dominant, not seven equal steps.
instituto.blackException: #000000 is a SANCTIONED terminus of this gradient and the only place black is permitted. Same category as the white raised-surface exception.

deckSupport.role: deck-derived. Use only when the institutional palette cannot distinguish enough elements in a template-based artifact. NOTE: magenta, violeta and indigo were previously filed here and are in fact brandbook Instituto gradient stops - see color.instituto.

supersededChart.role: SUPERSEDED for chart work by color.chart. Retained only to read and preserve older template-based charts.

assetLocal.role: Values that exist only inside specific exported files. Preserve in place; never globalize.

product.role: Tonal steps of the institutional palette, used ONLY through a color.semantic role. Never a brand colour, never a free accent.
product.authority: product layer, not brandbook. Read from the Kosmos Figma library Primitives collection. Only the steps a semantic role references are imported.
excluded: color/neutral/1000 #000000 - the black prohibition has one exception, the Instituto gradient terminus.
The remaining urucum and neutral steps - no role references them.
radius/6, 11, 16, 26, 38, 42 and pill - geometry.radius sanctions 10px and 4px only.
text/muted (neutral-400 on Gelo, 2.48:1) as a text role - it fails every text contrast floor.

semantic.role: The role layer every artifact should paint with. Only roles flip between themes; raw palette tokens never do (decision 0007).
semantic.authority: product layer, not brandbook. Roles mirror the Kosmos Figma Semantic collection (Light/Dark); departures are recorded per role.
semantic.valueGrammar: A string names a color.institutional or color.product token. {mix, percent} is that token at percent opacity (color-mix with transparent). {hex, exception} is a prohibited hex admitted by the named exception.

themes.dark: Opt-in, two ways: the .kunumi-theme-dark class forces it; the .kunumi-theme-auto class follows prefers-color-scheme. :root never follows the system on its own. See decision 0030.

roles.note: The Figma primitive is named paper-10 but stores 8% alpha. The name is taken as the intent.

roles.invariant: Urucum does not flip. It is the brand accent on both grounds.

roles.departure: Figma text/accent is full Urucum in Light, 3.13:1 on Gelo, which fails 4.5:1 for small text. urucum-700 measures 4.89:1; its dark value urucum-400 measures 5.08:1 on Chumbo but 4.48:1 on the dark raised surface, so small accent text stays off dark cards. Decision 0031, resolving 0022.
Figma sets Gelo on the Urucum fill, 3.13:1. Chumbo on Urucum measures 4.53:1. Decision 0032.

roles.note: Hover for a solid Urucum control carrying a Chumbo label. It lightens rather than darkens, because darkening lowers the Chumbo label below 4.5:1 (urucum-600 gives 3.65:1). Decision 0032.
Hover for a solid ink control.
Non-text contrast: Urucum on Gelo 3.13:1 and urucum-400 on Chumbo 5.08:1, both above the 3:1 floor of WCAG 1.4.11.
Disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums, so the state must never be signalled by colour alone.

display.fallbackOrderNote: Resolution policy for web delivery, not a brandbook list. PP Neue Machina is deliberately absent: see webDelivery and decision 0015. For print or a desktop deck, where the licensed file can travel with the document, Inktrap remains the brandbook's first choice.

webDelivery.why: Commercial software from Pangram Pangram. AGENTS.md forbids bundling it, so it can never be served to a browser. Naming it in a CSS stack only meant that a machine which happened to have it installed rendered titles in a face the delivered page cannot use.
webDelivery.evidence: Not metrically compatible with the alternate: "KONSTRUKT" at 100px measures 637.41px in PP Neue Machina against 584.91px in Space Grotesk, so the same HTML broke lines differently depending on which machine rendered it.

longTitle.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The brandbook prints no length limit for a title.
longTitle.note: Past two rendered lines the display face works against the title: uppercase removes the word shapes a reader scans by and +3% tracking widens lines that are already long. The team's own slide template reaches for Figtree sentence case in exactly this case. Distinct from fallbackOrder, which is about licensing and availability, not length.
longTitle.exemptRoleNote: An opening statement keeps the display face at any length. A statement asserts something about the brand on a surface whose job is to open; a title describes what is on the surface. Abertura/Titulo is 180px on a 1920 stage and wraps past two lines by design. The exemption removes the line limit only - uppercase and +3% tracking still apply. See decision 0018.

typography.hierarchyRule: As tipografias PP Neue Machina ou Space Grotesk são utilizadas exclusivamente como fontes de título, assumindo o papel de destaque visual. Já a Figtree é aplicada como fonte de corpo de texto e subtítulos.

scaleRatios.note: Ratios printed in the brandbook typography chapter, relative to the grid unit.
scaleRatios.title: 5x - 7.5x
scaleRatios.subtitle: 1.2x - 1.6x

emphasis.rule: Para destacar conteúdos em uma frase, utilize a ferramenta de highlight na cor chumbo ou urucum. A cor da tipografia deve acompanhar o fundo. Seu uso deve ser dosado e pontual, evite marcar muitas palavras em uma mesma frase. Ele não deve ser aplicado em títulos.

productRamp.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The Kosmos Figma UI/* text styles.
productRamp.tension: Decision 0019 admits a product ramp only when it keeps two brandbook steps at their literal values (22px Miolo/Titulo, 13px Cabecalho/Menu). This ramp keeps neither; Overline is 12px. Recorded in decision 0034, not mirrored into kunumi-tokens.css until it is ruled on.

fluid.authority: product layer. Codifies the clamp() values kunumi-tokens.css already ships; changing one here means changing the CSS too.
fluid.note: The brandbook sizes are measured on a 1920 stage. On the web the stage size is the ceiling, reached at wide viewports, never the default.

radius.note: The brandbook's card and button components use a 10px radius. Hairline rules and edge alignment remain the dominant language; rounded containers are not a default.
radius.controlNote: Product layer, not brandbook. Small controls (inputs, checkboxes, radios, switches) where the 10px card radius reads too soft. Mirrored as --kunumi-radius-sm.

geometry.cardPaddingNote: 30px is a brandbook value and deliberately sits off the 4px product spacing scale. Do not round it to 32px (--kunumi-space-8); use --kunumi-card-padding.

spacing.role: Shared product spacing scale for screen work.
spacing.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The brandbook prints no screen spacing scale.
spacing.naming: cssVar is --kunumi-space-<px/4>; the Figma variable is named for its pixel value.

layout.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The Kosmos Figma grid styles, which label their own breakpoints as invented. Adopted by decision 0029.

breakpoints.note: min-width only. A custom property cannot appear inside @media, so the engine reads minWidthPx from here and the CSS writes the number literally.
breakpoints.maxWidthToleranceNote: A max-width query may sit up to 1px below a breakpoint (767px, 767.98px) so it meets the matching min-width query without overlap.

container.derivation: 1440 - 2 x 96: the desktop grid's content width.

layout.composition: Dois por dois (brandbook): two major horizontal blocks, two major vertical blocks, then subdivide. A way of reading the page on the column grid, not four mandatory cards.

motion.reducedMotion: Every animated artifact honours prefers-reduced-motion; a dimmed pre-state must resolve under it (decision 0027).

elevation.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The Kosmos Figma effect styles. Hairlines and edge alignment remain the dominant language; elevation only where it clarifies hierarchy or state.

entries.use: a resting card lifted off the Gelo ground

elevation.excluded: Elevation/Stage is a presentation shadow for slide replicas, never a UI surface.

interaction.statesNote: The Figma Button carries Default, Hover and Disabled only. Active and focus-visible are specified here and in kunumi-tokens.css.

focusRing.authority: product layer; WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 (focus visible) and 1.4.11 (non-text contrast). Width and offset await brand approval.
focusRing.rule: Draw the ring on the interactive element, never on the mark inside it (logo.no-effects). Never remove an outline on :focus without drawing a replacement.

targetSize.authority: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (minimum 24px) and the Kosmos Figma Icon Button note (44px recommended for touch).

interaction.disabled: Use the disabled attribute or aria-disabled=true. Signal it by surface-disabled and ink-disabled plus the not-allowed cursor, never by opacity on the whole control alone.

components.authority: product layer, not brandbook. The Kosmos Figma Button and Icon Button, radius from geometry.radius.card.

button.variantsNote: Figma also has destructive and link variants and a Gradient hover property. Destructive waits for an approved error colour. Link is a text link, not a button. Gradient hover paints the Instituto gradient and is admissible only under the web.instituto scope.
button.sizesNote: Figma draws the default button 38px tall. The web default is 40px so every height sits on the 4px spacing scale; the other three match Figma exactly.

iconButton.shape: square; the height of the matching button size
iconButton.touchNote: xs 28 and sm 32 sit below the 44px touch recommendation. Pointer-dense surfaces only, never a primary touch target.

input.note: The Kosmos library has no input yet. Until one is designed and approved: control radius (4px), border role, ink text, the focus ring, and never a placeholder as the only label.

navigation.current: Mark the current page with aria-current=page; it is shown by an Urucum rule under the item, not by colour of the text alone.

icons.authority: product layer. No approved Kunumi icon set exists; the Kosmos Figma Iconography page is a utility set and labelled as invented.
icons.rule: Icons are line drawings in currentColor, sized to the button they sit in. Never an icon in the brand mark's place, never a substitute for the symbol.

logo.authority: Brandbook Kunumi Final (2025), chapter marca. See logo-governance.md.

clearSpace.definition: X is one third of the lockup height, kept clear on every side.
clearSpace.note: The brandbook prints the module, not a pixel value. The px table in web-specs.md is arithmetic on it, not a new rule.

minHeight.otherVersionsNote: The brandbook prints 28px for the positive RGB lockup only. Do not extrapolate it to other versions or to the symbol alone; ask for the approved value.

digital.authority: Platform conventions, not brandbook: Open Graph, the HTML and web-app-manifest icon conventions, and each channel's published format. Channel sizes change; re-check the channel before a campaign.

og.note: One image per page, declared with og:image, og:image:width and og:image:height.

appIcons.source: assets/local/brand-marks/shared/ (the approved symbol), resampled, never redrawn (decision 0028).

entries.use: web app manifest, also the maskable icon

appIcons.pending: The brandbook prints no minimum for the symbol alone and no favicon polarity. Both need brand approval. Decision 0035.

social.safeArea: keep type out of the top and bottom 250px
